capabilities: Browse story entities as cards in the Anvil
Edit entity frontmatter in Anvil and Workbench panes
Show scenes on a Timeline, Plotgrid, Plotlines and status Board
Follow the active note's linked entities in the Workbench sidebar
Install ready-made collections as .base or .md files
disambiguation: Not a long-form manuscript editor; it only reads and edits story entity frontmatter and shows views over it.
extras: Makes no network requests, accounts or telemetry; reads the full vault file list and frontmatter via Obsidian's metadata cache, which the community directory flags as "vault enumeration". Optional DataviewJS collections execute code after user consent. Not yet listed in the community directory; install manually or via BRAT (MMoMM-org/obsidian-story-forge). Detailed docs live in a docs/ folder in the repository.
problem: Story notes keep characters, places and lore in scattered frontmatter and wikilinks, with no way to browse or edit them as a story overview inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT, a community plugin that installs plugins straight from GitHub
DataviewJS collections run code (through the Dataview plugin)

summary: Story-writing workspace that shows story entities from note frontmatter as cards in an Anvil view and linked entities in a Workbench sidebar.
